title: The Ark Rests on the Mountains of Ararat
summary: "And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat."
description: Genesis 8:4. The mountain tops become visible on the 1st day of the 10th month (Gen 8:5).

sorting_basis.note: No tier 1-4 gives a BC year for the landing itself (Ussher prints only AM 1656 + 6 May). sorting_year copied from the-flood (CFAH AP-29) and ordered after it via sort_order_within_year.

chronologies.note: pending CFAH reference. CFAH-4 AP-29 dates the Flood year (2348–2347 B.C.) but not the landing day
Not stated in the Jones sources read (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament 15th ed. 2002, Chronological Compendium p. 1). Leave empty until verified.

chronologies.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, First Age, §36 (1658 scan: "May 6, upon a wedensday")
chronologies.note: year_bc_ad left null: Ussher's AM 1656 heading reads 2349 BC, but because his year begins in autumn, 6 May would fall in Julian 2348 BC. That conversion is derived, not printed by Ussher. Many secondary summaries give 5 May; the 1658 text reads 6 May.

chronologies.date: "the Ark rested (invisibly) on Mount Ararat, on 7/17/1656, which is a Tuesday"
chronologies.citation: Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 2)," Biblical Chronology 6:4 (April 1994), §5 "The Chronology of the Flood Year"
chronologies.note: Weekday is Jordan's provisional reconstruction (sabbath pattern). Tops of mountains visible 10/1/1656; surface dry and Ark uncovered 1/1/1657 (Gen 8:13).
